item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line U.S. Flag
item_short_desc: Elevate your respect and support for first responders, public safety officals, and police with Rothco’s Thin Blue Line U.S. Flag. Crafted from durable polyester, this flag features a striking Thin Blue Line design. Double-stitched for durability, the flag withstands outdoor elements with ease, ensuring long-lasting display. Beyond its patriotic significance, purchasing this flag contributes to a noble cause; proceeds benefit the families of fallen first responders, providing essential support during challenging times.
